metadata.title: Phase 1A.2a — Executable UI Action Binding Index
metadata.method: TypeScript AST over accepted Phase 1A.1 pages, ancestor Next.js route boundaries and recursively resolved local imports using apps/union-eyes/tsconfig.json aliases. Each JSX event/action prop is counted once at its source site; handler bodies and downstream effects are not followed.

excludes: sources outside canonical static page/import closure

limitations: This source census does not prove callback success, API reachability, persistence, authorization or runtime reachability.
A repeated row/template control is counted once per source binding pattern, not by runtime row cardinality.
Shared-component audience scope is the union of statically importing Phase 1A.1 page audience classes, not proof of visibility or authorization.
Outside-closure historical candidates retain handler identities but are not promoted into the canonical active universe without a current page/import edge.
Prop-forwarding spreads are not counted as extra action entries; explicit callsite bindings are counted. Every direct event/action prop in the scanned closure has an identity.

gateBasis: Accepted Phase 1A.1 pages and route-boundary sources enumerated
Transitive local UI import closure inspected
Every direct event/action prop binding has a current source identity

suspiciousControlFindings.methodology: Source-pattern flags only; no claim that a control is deceptive or ineffective without runtime/effect evidence.

legacyScanReconciliation.unreconciledMeaning: Current handler identity exists for each residual candidate, but its source is outside the static import closure of the accepted pages and route-boundary files; active reachability is not established.
